scope: Independent full handwritten bodies/fixture and intended public API review, with baseline and accepted-wave semantic comparison. Source/hash/JSON/Python AST and node syntax only; no fixture import, JS/SQL body execution, reference runtime, SUT, build or download.
contract_review: Checked ready-epoch transitions, initialization admission, close readiness, TransformStream demand/flush ordering, and weighted readable pull decisions against the primary WHATWG snapshot. Correct intended oracles remain unchanged for source-predicted failures.
duplicate_review: Baseline S020/B015 serialization, S024/X012 ownership handoff, S206 held pipe close, X015 native delayed consumption, and original tests/streams coarse pressure/prefetch are distinct. Generic bytes/EOF/FIFO/cleanup checks earn no extra case credit. No HWM/chunk/length parameter grid.

case_verdicts.reason: Weighted readiness promise epochs, including readiness with another write still held; generic FIFO is scaffold.
Successful asynchronous sink start separately gates callback admission while initial readiness can already fulfill.
Queued close resolves pressure readiness before either held write or close completion.
Default TransformStream read demand must gate each transform; source omits this coordination.
Successful held flush produces one tail before terminal EOF, with demand-compatible prefix setup.
Readable weighted capacity controls pull admission after actual pull settlement; source instead counts chunks.

source_predicted_gaps.inference: Ordinary transform write immediately enqueues/calls transform without a read-demand gate.
desiredSize uses weighted queue size, but pull admission computes HWM minus queue.length.

S306 joins the exact returned first pull result before a task fence and no-refill observation.
Future resource/teardown envelope now covers dev, esbuild and runtime across separate PGIDs; temporary bundles/logs/store share an owned quota domain. Single-PGID fallback disallowed.

execution_contract.real_surface: Actual deployed direct-celld Worker global ReadableStream/WritableStream/TransformStream/ByteLengthQueuingStrategy, no replacement stream algorithm.

resource_envelope.required_scope: Proven-owned whole-descendant execution domain covering dev, bundlers and node even across separate PGIDs; for example an already provisioned cgroup.
resource_envelope.filesystem_scope: Temporary bundles, logs and stores all remain inside the same owned quota/cleanup domain.

execution_contract.cleanup: Open every gate; initiate both readable cancellation and writable abortion before joining; join all original/ready/closed/callback observations including those added during settlement; release owners, observe released getters, require zero pending work/locks/timers. Unsettled/native stalls require bounded external owned-domain reap.
execution_contract.limits_qualification: Schedule is a deferred contract, not provisioned enforcement. Whole-domain membership, quota/limits and final emptiness/store removal require independent runtime evidence; no privileged setup or live authorization is inferred.

OS_relevance.qualification: Caller constructs TransformStream and pipes prefix then content. It does not prove custom weights or user flush adoption. No full checkout/dependency/actual OS execution claim; no extra pipe case credit.
